text:
Ethan Brooks: FYI we just got a customer report showing tail latency spikes after the latest marketplace runtime pushed with driver 536.x + CUDA12.4. Looks like quantized workloads primarily.

Maya Chen: Hmm. Which hardware? A100/H100? Any logs?

Ethan Brooks: Customer ran on A100-80GB. They attached a perf snippet: avg token latency doubled in worst cases.

Priya Singh: Short checklist before we escalate to partners: repro, exact image tag, sample workload, and top-line numbers. Who can pull the canary logs?

Juno Ops: I can fetch canary artifacts. Deploy bot shows recent marketplace run: marketplace/gpu-runtime:2026-04-10-canary-536. Retrieving logs now.

deploy-bot: Artifact fetched -> s3://redwood-canaries/2026-04-10/marketplace-536/logs.tar.gz

Carlos (NVidiaPartner): NVidia engineering: we saw a scheduler tweak in 536 that can affect int8/qint matmuls on tiled workloads. We're investigating. Can you share the reproducer?

MatrixSI Liaison: MatrixSI customers reported similar after they applied the marketplace image to their integration clusters. We've put a temporary hold on downstream upgrades.

Maya Chen: Proposal: hold the marketplace GA rollout for runtime images that bundle driver 536. Open a temporary pin to last-known-good driver 525.x for marketplace images and create a canary lane that uses 525 vs 536 for A/B perf comparison.

Ethan Brooks: Agreed. Also add an emergency flag in the marketplace deployment pipeline to stop promotion automatically if p99 regression > 20% for quant workloads.

Priya Singh: I'll draft the pipeline gating rule. Quick snippet to add to the pipeline config:
```
if p99_quant > baseline_p99 * 1.20:
  fail_promotion: true
```

Carlos (NVidiaPartner): We'll aim to produce a micro-patch or driver recommendation within 36 hours. In the meantime, driver 525.85 is the stable fallback we recommend.

Juno Ops: Ops action items:
- Freeze marketplace upload queue for 536 variants (owner: Juno)
- Create 525 pinned image lane and run smoke + perf (owner: Maya)
- Post public-facing guidance draft for partners (owner: Ethan)

Maya Chen: Starting the 525 vs 536 canary A/B now. Tests: perf (avg/p99), throughput, and simple correctness on quant model set. Will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Canary jobs queued: job-9001 (525), job-9002 (536).

Priya Singh: Docs note: add a short comms snippet for marketplace release notes and partner alerts. We should avoid technical minutiae in the customer note. docs-bot, can you create a draft?

docs-bot: Draft created -> https://confluence.redwood/prod/marketplace-driver-pinning-draft (internal).

MatrixSI Liaison: MatrixSI will echo the guidance to SI integration engineers and customers in our early-adopter pool. Adding ops@matrixsi.com to the runbook.

Carlos (NVidiaPartner): NVidia: please attach minimal reproducer (docker + input blob) and we will triage kernel scheduler path. If we confirm a regression we will coordinate a joint comms plan.

Ethan Brooks: I'll prepare a short joint statement template so partners can align messaging. Suggestion: keep it to 2 bullets: what happened, what we're doing about it, and ETA for next update.

Maya Chen: First canary pass: 525 lane median ~1.9ms, p99 ~3.1ms. 536 lane median ~2.4ms, p99 ~4.7ms. Numbers look consistent with the customer report. Uploading logs to the canary bucket.

Juno Ops: Promotion hold enacted at 14:12 UTC. Marketplace uploads for 536 variants blocked until clearance.

Priya Singh: Add rollback playbook link to the thread for SREs and partner ops: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/marketplace-rollback

Carlos (NVidiaPartner): NVidia will prioritize a micro-patch and test on A100/H100. We'll update here when we have a candidate or a confirmed workaround.

Ethan Brooks: Owners recap: Maya (canary analysis + 525 lane), Juno Ops (freeze + pipeline gate), Priya (playbook + gating rule), Carlos (vendor triage), MatrixSI Liaison (SI comms).

Maya Chen: I'll publish a short partner status email once I have the full canary logs (ETA 3h).

Ethan Brooks: Thanks everyone. We'll convene a 20-min align at 09:00 UTC tomorrow if there isn't a patch earlier. If NVidia posts a patch sooner we'll do fast validation and then decide on unfreezing the rollout. :phone:

deploy-bot: job-9001 (525) -> completed. job-9002 (536) -> completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-canaries/2026-04-10/marketplace-compare/

Maya Chen: Uploaded perf CSVs and short analysis summary to the canary bucket. Initial verdict: 525 pin mitigates the regression for quant workloads.

Ethan Brooks: I'll post the joint comms draft to the partners channel and tag NVidia and MatrixSI. Closing this thread for action tracking — update here with any patch or change to the gate.

MatrixSI Liaison: Noted, will coordinate SI channels.
